title: The dual is sign-valued
statement: Let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ be bent. Then its dual function, obtained by multiplying each Walsh Fourier coefficient of $f$ by $2^{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}$, takes values of absolute value $1$.
